tldr: Venus in Taurus: love is sensual, steady, and rooted in tangible care.
body: With Venus in Taurus, Venus is at home, so pleasure, loyalty, beauty, and embodiment are strong. You value consistency that can be felt in the body.
gift: Sensuality, loyalty, aesthetic instinct, and the ability to build comfort and value.
challenge: Possessiveness, indulgence, and staying comfortable at the expense of growth.
note: Authored from Marie Satori planet-through-sign material.
